evaluation_identity.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators

dataset_identity.scope: exact raw source bytes consumed by the evaluator

shard_verification.algorithm: binary SHA-256 Merkle root over sorted evaluation-ID bytes
shard_verification.odd_node_rule: duplicate final node at each odd tree layer

count_rule.current_phase: exact unique evaluation-ID ledger plus Merkle shards
count_rule.trillion_phase: sum evaluation_count across accepted unique shard_id values after shard validation
count_rule.collision_or_overlap_rule: a distributed planner must assign non-overlapping canonical parameter ranges; overlapping shard ranges are rejected before count aggregation

compute_architecture.github_actions: control plane, bounded verified jobs, ledger publication
